name: Hask
title: Outfitter
examine: Fifteen High Road winters are written on his face, mostly around the scar. He is looking at your boots and finding them wanting.
lines: Show me your boots. Mm. You'll want better before the Fork.
Fifteen years walking Waykeeper escort. I trained half the watch on this wall — Aldis was the one who trained back.
The road doesn't kill people. Being underprepared for the road kills people. I sell the difference.
